assumptions: Inference, never a fact: Oculus Browser and Oculus Desktop are deployed on the same Windows host.
Inference, never a fact: successful exploitation of the source would provide usable code execution in a local unprivileged context.
Inference, never a fact: the attacker can perform the target's hard-link file-write vector after obtaining that context.

evidence_quotes.quote: A remote web page could inject arbitrary HTML code into the Oculus Browser UI, allowing an attacker to spoof UI and potentially execute code.

Writing to an unprivileged file from a privileged OVRRedir.exe process in Oculus Desktop before 1.44.0.32849 on Windows allows local users to write to arbitrary files and consequently gain privileges via vectors involving a hard link to a log file.

missing_conditions: A victim actually visits or loads the attacker-controlled remote page.
CVE-2019-3562 exploitation achieves code execution rather than only HTML injection or UI spoofing.
The resulting execution provides a usable local unprivileged user context.
Oculus Browser and the affected Oculus Desktop installation are co-resident on the same Windows host.
The target host runs Oculus Desktop before 1.44.0.32849 and includes the vulnerable privileged OVRRedir.exe behavior.
The local user can arrange and trigger the hard-link-to-log-file vector described by CVE-2020-1885.
response.reason: CVE-2019-3562 describes HTML injection into the Oculus Browser UI and only says an attacker can "potentially execute code"; it does not establish code execution or its host context. CVE-2020-1885 describes arbitrary-file writes by a privileged OVRRedir.exe process on Windows, with local users gaining privileges through a hard-link-to-log-file vector. A causal bridge is therefore plausible only if the source exploit yields local unprivileged execution on the same Windows host as the affected Oculus Desktop installation and the target-specific hard-link conditions hold. No environment evidence establishes those relationships or prerequisites, so the edge should not enter a strict graph as an unconditional supported edge; it is conditional.
